notes: Japan edition, from Nintendo’s Japanese original NINTENDO64 software pages (or the official Super Mario 64 history panel naming its 1996 NINTENDO 64 release). The publisher site’s Japanese-market context establishes JP and its N64 software namespace establishes the platform; numeric date spelling is normalized to ISO. The Japanese title is retained as printed. A later Virtual Console release date is never substituted for the cartridge release.

This record uses the normal cartridge edition. The page advertises both a cartridge-only purchase and an Expansion Pak bundle; no complete bundled[] is assigned across those packages. Gold/other cartridge colors do not justify a new shell geometry.

Edition metadata only. Package dimensions, the exact retail package revision/product code, booklet page count including covers, trim and binding, loose inserts and complete bundled contents are unresolved unless explicitly sourced below. Omitted inserts/bundled lists mean unknown, not none. No box/manual geometry or artwork is supplied. No claim of physical fit follows from this record.

Ritsumeikan Center for Game Studies physical-package record PACKAGE0010625 identifies this catalogued Japanese issue by its transcribed 型番 and 商品識別コード. Product code spelling is preserved verbatim; it is not a code inferred from a manual URL, platform, or expected prefix. The catalogue’s own physical metadata is used at museum tier; embedded Wikipedia summaries and externally sourced release dates are not used. Nintendo supplies the release date. A product code/EAN identifies an issue but does not establish every manufacturing revision or universal pack-in contents.

Raw catalog_* extents remain exactly as reported. The catalogue’s own Game Cataloging Manual v1.00, p.24, resolves their dimension semantics: three values are height × width × depth in cm; a circular carrier’s single value is diameter; a booklet’s single value is height. Derived features convert only the source’s reported values to mm. Package measurements describe the physical package, not an inside cavity, tray, wall or retention profile. Booklet height is not asserted to be complete leaf trim; page_width_mm and page_height_mm remain null. No dimensions are copied into a universal media-format object.

Separate Expansion Pak bundle, not a revision inferred from the cartridge-only issue. The catalogued specimen lists an operation table, Expansion Pak, Jumper Pak ejector and instruction material. bundled covers its two hardware accessories; loose printed inserts remain unresolved. Reserved accessory keys may produce unresolved-reference notes. This specimen’s 39-page extent differs from the other issue’s 40 pages; neither is silently normalized.

Measurement precision is retained, not improved: a reported 0.1 cm digit corresponds to 1 mm, while integer-cm literals publish no subcentimetre digit. Unit conversion does not assert a manufacturing tolerance. Each SKU keeps its own carrier measurements, including the Majora’s Mask Expansion Pak bundle’s 7.6 × 11.5 × 1.8 cm versus 7.5 × 11.5 × 1.9 cm for the other two N64 issues. The resulting rectangular envelope is a size fact, not a detailed likeness or fabrication/fit verification.

Game Cataloging Manual v1.00 p.23 distinguishes analysed numbered pagination from unnumbered page counts that explicitly omit front/back cover faces. The record’s numbered page extent does not establish covers-inclusive total by itself; no automatic +4 is applied. edition.booklet.pages and binding remain null.
